name: The Festival of the Blazing Sun
summary: Baron Vallakovich holds a festival every week to prove Vallaki is happy. This one, with its great wicker sun, will decide who rules the town.

stages.journal: The watch at Vallaki's gate told us the Baron is holding the Festival of the Blazing Sun in the town square. Attendance is required. So is cheering.
objectives: Attend the festival in the town square

stages.journal: We agreed to stand with Baron Vallakovich at the festival. He wants his wicker sun to burn and his enemies to be seen to fail.
objectives: Keep watch over the wicker sun the night before (optional)
Stand by the Baron at the festival

stages.journal: We agreed to stand with Lady Wachter. When the Baron's festival goes wrong, she means to take the town from him in front of everyone.
objectives: Make sure the wicker sun won't burn (optional)
Stand with Lady Wachter at the festival

stages.journal: We told Father Lucian we would back neither the Baron nor Lady Wachter, and stand with the people of Vallaki when the festival comes.
objectives: Find proof of what Lady Wachter is (optional)
Protect the townsfolk at the festival

stages.journal: The Festival of the Blazing Sun has begun. The whole town is in the square, and so are we.
The festival ended with Lady Wachter's coup broken and the Baron still in his chair. Vallaki keeps its festivals, its curfew and its stocks. All, the Baron insists, is well.
The festival ended with the Baron dragged from his dais. Lady Wachter rules Vallaki now, and she makes no secret of whose favour she rules it by.
The festival ended with the town on its feet. Neither the Baron nor Lady Wachter rules Vallaki now; Father Lucian and Urwin Martikov speak for a council of its people.
